app_info.subtitle: Schedule Social Media Posts
app_info.description:
Postiz helps users manage social media publishing from ChatGPT.  Users can:
- Schedule social media posts to 28+ platforms including X, LinkedIn, LinkedIn Pages, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, YouTube, TikTok, Reddit, Pinterest, Bluesky, Mastodon, Google My Business, Discord, Slack, Telegram, Twitch, Kick, Lemmy, Farcaster, Nostr, VK, MeWe, Tumblr, Skool, Whop, Moltbook, Dribbble, Medium, Dev.to, Hashnode, WordPress, and ListMonk
- List connected channels and groups
- Inspect platform requirements
- Upload or generate media
- Turn long YouTube videos into short clips
- Create drafts or scheduled posts
- Update provider settings
- Review upcoming posts
- Delete posts.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves connected social channels for the organization and optional group filter.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the organization's customer groups.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns platform rules, limits, settings schemas, and helper metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can refresh stored integration tokens and mark channels as needing reconnect while retrieving provider details.
justifications.open_world_justification: Calls connected provider APIs and can update integration auth state for the user's channel.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite stored integration tokens or mark a channel as needing reconnect if refresh fails.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates draft, scheduled, or immediate social posts and starts publishing workflows.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can publish or schedule content to external social media channels.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can send public social posts immediately or later through connected platforms.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves posts scheduled, drafted, published, or errored in a requested date window.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Merges new provider settings into an existing draft or scheduled post.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only updates settings stored on an unpublished Postiz post and does not reach any external or publicly visible system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites existing provider settings on an unpublished draft or scheduled post, which changes how it will be published; it does not delete posts, change content or dates, or publish immediately.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes an existing post and its comments on one channel in Postiz.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only deletes the post inside Postiz; a published post stays live on the social network and no third-party system is changed.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently deletes the post (every repetition of a repeating post) and its comments from Postiz, so a scheduled post is no longer published; this cannot be undone.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves one post of the organization with its parts, media, channel and settings.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves a page of the organization's posts, or the earlier posts up to a date.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the click counts of the shortened links of a post.
justifications.open_world_justification: Asks the short link service for the clicks of the links; nothing is written to it.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can store the id of the published post on a Postiz post whose id was not captured.
justifications.open_world_justification: Looks up the published post and the recent content of the channel on the connected social network; nothing is published or changed there.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the stored release id of a post whose id is marked as missing, and only after the user picked the candidate.

justifications.read_only_justification: Adds a review comment to a post or marks a comment as resolved.
justifications.open_world_justification: Review comments stay inside Postiz and are never published on a social network.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite anything: it adds a comment or toggles whether a comment is resolved.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates, renames, recolors and deletes tags of the organization.
justifications.open_world_justification: Tags stay inside Postiz and do not reach any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Deleting a tag removes it from every post that has it and cannot be undone; renaming overwrites the previous name and color.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only calculates the next free time for a post; nothing is scheduled.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only checks posts against the channel rules and link shortening; nothing is created.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Generates post text and optionally pictures, and saves the generated pictures in the media library.
justifications.open_world_justification: Researches the topic on the internet and sends the request to an AI provider to write the text and pictures.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite or publish anything; it only returns new text and adds new media.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates draft posts on the enabled channels for a chosen week.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only creates drafts inside Postiz; nothing is published on any social network.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite anything; it only adds new drafts.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes the publish date of a post and can put it back in the queue.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes the date inside Postiz; the post is published later by the normal schedule.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the publish date of the post, and with the schedule action clears its published link and queues it again; a published post is refused unless the user explicitly asks to publish it again.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns the text split into parts; nothing is stored or scheduled.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends the text to an AI provider to split it into parts.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists available video generation types, required parameters, helper functions, and whether the account may use each type now.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves helper data needed for video generation, such as available voice IDs.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not create public content or change third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts a background video generation job that consumes the user's video generation credit, uploads the result, and saves it to the media library.
justifications.open_world_justification: Calls external generation and storage services to create media for the user's workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite existing media, revoke access, or publish content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the status of a video generation job the user started and returns the hosted video URL once it is done.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Generates an image (optionally writing the picture description from the text of a post first), consumes the user's image generation credit, uploads the result, and saves it to the media library.
justifications.open_world_justification: Calls external generation and storage services to create media for the user's workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite existing media, revoke access, or publish content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches a public media URL, uploads the file, and saves it to the media library; with adjust set to true it also starts a background job that adjusts the file to the platforms' limits.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads from a public URL and stores the resulting media through external storage; with adjust set to true an external media processing service adjusts the file.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite existing media, revoke access, or publish content; with adjust set to true the adjusted file replaces only the file uploaded by this call.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads whether a media uploaded with adjust set to true finished adjusting, and returns its path.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads internal Postiz data for the user's workspace only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists the media already in the user's media library, optionally searched by filename.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads internal Postiz data for the user's workspace only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Opens an upload session and shows a widget the user uploads media to their own media library with; the user can tick an option to adjust the uploaded files to the platforms' limits.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only creates an upload session inside the user's Postiz workspace; nothing is published or sent to a third party.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite existing media, revoke access, or publish content; when the user ticks the adjust option, the adjusted file replaces only the file uploaded in that session.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a short-lived upload ticket for the upload widget; it is only callable by the widget, not by the model.
justifications.open_world_justification: The ticket only allows uploads into the user's own Postiz media library; no public or third-party state changes.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite anything, revoke access, or publish content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the media uploaded in an upload widget session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads internal Postiz data for the user's workspace only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only; it cannot change or delete anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts a background clipping job that downloads a public YouTube video, renders short vertical clips with captions, consumes the user's clipping minutes, and saves every clip to the media library; when channels are passed it also creates draft posts.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads a public YouTube URL and calls external rendering and storage services to create media for the user's workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite existing media or posts, revoke access, or publish content; any posts it creates are drafts only.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the status of a clipping job the user started and returns the hosted clip URLs once it is done.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a short-lived ticket for the clipping widget to read the progress of a clipping job; it is only callable by the widget, not by the model.
justifications.open_world_justification: The ticket only allows reading the user's own clipping job inside Postiz; no public or third-party state changes.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite anything, revoke access, or publish content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists the social platforms a channel can be connected to.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a one hour authorization link for the user to connect or reconnect a channel; the channel itself is only created when the user authorizes in their browser.
justifications.open_world_justification: Asks the social platform for the authorization page of the link; nothing is published or changed on it.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite anything; reconnecting only refreshes the connection of the channel after the user authorizes it.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves one channel with its posting times and settings, never its credentials.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Renames a channel in Postiz and replaces its settings.
justifications.open_world_justification: Names and settings stay inside Postiz and do not reach the social network.
justifications.destructive_justification: Saving the settings replaces the whole previous list and renaming replaces the previous name.

justifications.read_only_justification: Puts channels in groups, creates a group by name and renames a group.
justifications.open_world_justification: Groups stay inside Postiz and do not reach the social network.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete anything; it moves a channel between groups and renames groups.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes the name and picture of the account on the social platform.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends the new name and picture to the connected social network, where everyone can see them.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the current name and picture of the account on the social network.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sets the posting times of a channel.
justifications.open_world_justification: Posting times stay inside Postiz and do not reach the social network.
justifications.destructive_justification: Replaces the whole previous list of posting times of the channel.

justifications.read_only_justification: Enables, disables or deletes a channel.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes the channel inside Postiz; the account on the social network is not touched.
justifications.destructive_justification: Deleting a channel also deletes all its posts, scheduled posts are no longer published, and it cannot be undone; disabling stops posting to the channel.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches the accounts a post can mention; Postiz remembers the accounts it finds for the next search.
justifications.open_world_justification: Asks the social platform to search its accounts; nothing is written to it.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the plugs of the channels, sets up a plug and turns it on or off.
justifications.open_world_justification: Plugs are stored inside Postiz; they run later against the connected account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Saving a plug replaces its previous values and turning a plug off stops its automation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the analytics of a channel or of a published post from the social network; no post, media or setting is created or changed. As housekeeping of the connection, an expired channel token is refreshed first and saved, and if that refresh fails the channel is marked as disconnected so that it can be reconnected.
justifications.open_world_justification: Asks the connected social network for the numbers of the account or post; it never posts or changes anything there.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Saves the alt text and thumbnail of a media in the library and removes media from the library.
justifications.open_world_justification: Media stays inside Postiz and the change does not reach any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Deleting a media removes it from the media library and cannot be undone; updating overwrites the previous alt text and thumbnail.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists the clippings of the user's workspace with their status.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads internal Postiz data for the user's workspace only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads how many AI credits the workspace has left this month.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads internal Postiz data for the user's workspace only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the conversations and messages of the in-app copilot of the user's workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads internal Postiz data for the user's workspace only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the notifications of the user; listing them marks them as read for the user, like opening the bell in the app.
justifications.open_world_justification: Notifications stay inside Postiz and nothing reaches an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite any notification, revoke access, or send content; it only moves the user's last-read time forward.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the members of the organization, creates invitation links and removes members.
justifications.open_world_justification: Members and invitations stay inside Postiz; the optional invitation email is sent only when the user asks for it, to the address they give.
justifications.destructive_justification: Removing a member takes their access to the organization away immediately, including the connections they approved, and cannot be undone.

justifications.read_only_justification: Adds an existing Postiz account to the organization; only the super admin of the instance is allowed.
justifications.open_world_justification: Settings stay inside Postiz and nothing reaches an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only adds a member; nothing is deleted, overwritten, revoked or sent.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the short link preference of the organization.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads internal Postiz data for the user's workspace only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Saves the short link preference of the organization.
justifications.open_world_justification: Settings stay inside Postiz and nothing reaches an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites a single setting that can be set back to any value; nothing is deleted, revoked or sent.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the account of the connected user and saves their name, bio, email notification flags and timezone.
justifications.open_world_justification: Settings stay inside Postiz and nothing reaches an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the user's own profile settings, which can be set again; nothing is deleted, revoked or sent. It never returns a password or an API key.

justifications.read_only_justification: Replaces the API key of the organization with a new one and returns it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Settings stay inside Postiz and nothing reaches an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: The old API key stops working immediately and everything using it breaks until it is given the new key; it cannot be undone.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the subscription of the organization and the plans that can be bought; nothing is bought or changed.
justifications.open_world_justification: The plans that can be bought are read from the payment provider.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the organizations of the connected user and lets them accept an invitation they were given.
justifications.open_world_justification: Settings stay inside Postiz and nothing reaches an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Joining only adds the user to an organization; nothing is deleted, overwritten, revoked or sent.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads what deleting the account takes with it and deletes the account of the connected user.
justifications.open_world_justification: Deleting the account cancels the subscription at the payment provider.
justifications.destructive_justification: Deletes the account, the organizations the user owns alone with their channels and posts, and cancels the subscription; it cannot be undone and only goes ahead after the user confirmed what it takes with it.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads, creates, updates and deletes the OAuth application of the organization and rotates its client secret.
justifications.open_world_justification: Settings stay inside Postiz and nothing reaches an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Rotating the secret makes the old one stop working immediately, and deleting the application revokes every connection made through it; neither can be undone.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the apps the user approved and revokes approvals.
justifications.open_world_justification: Settings stay inside Postiz and nothing reaches an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Revoking an approval makes that app stop working immediately; the user can approve it again later.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists, creates, updates and deletes the signatures of the organization.
justifications.open_world_justification: Signatures stay inside Postiz and nothing reaches an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Deleting a signature removes it for good, and saving one as the default makes the previous default stop being it.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists, creates, updates and deletes the sets (post templates) of the organization.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sets stay inside Postiz and nothing reaches an external system; a set schedules nothing.
justifications.destructive_justification: Deleting a set removes it for good, and updating one replaces its name and content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists, updates, starts, pauses and deletes autoposts and tests an RSS feed.
justifications.open_world_justification: The test and an active autopost read an RSS feed at a public https address the user gave; internal network addresses are refused.
justifications.destructive_justification: Deleting an autopost removes it and stops it for good; updating replaces its settings.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates an autopost that follows an RSS feed and creates draft posts out of its new items.
justifications.open_world_justification: An active autopost reads an RSS feed at a public https address the user gave; internal network addresses are refused.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only adds an autopost; nothing is deleted or overwritten, and it only creates drafts, nothing is published.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists, updates and deletes webhooks and sends a test request to one.
justifications.open_world_justification: The send action posts a JSON body the user asked for to a public https address they gave; internal network addresses are refused.
justifications.destructive_justification: Deleting a webhook stops what is sent to it and cannot be undone; updating replaces its name, address and channels.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a webhook that receives the posts published on its channels.
justifications.open_world_justification: Published posts are sent to the public https address the user gave; internal network addresses are refused.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only adds a webhook; nothing is deleted or overwritten.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the third-party apps, connects one with the API key the user gave, disconnects it, runs its functions and brings its media into the library.
justifications.open_world_justification: Connecting, running a function, submitting and importing call the third-party service the user connected; the stored API key is never returned.
justifications.destructive_justification: Disconnecting forgets the stored API key and cannot be undone; the media already made stays.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the failed posts, the usage statistics and the user search of the whole instance, and only for the super admin of the instance; everyone else is refused.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads Postiz's own database and nothing reaches an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or send content; it cannot start an impersonation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the announcements and, for the super admin of the instance only, creates and deletes them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Announcements stay inside Postiz and nothing reaches an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Deleting an announcement removes it for every user and cannot be undone; only the super admin of the instance can do it.

test_cases.description: List the user's connected Postiz channels.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which social channels do I have connected in Postiz? Show the platform and channel name for each one.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls integrationList and lists every connected channel with its platform (for example LinkedIn, X) and channel name, so the user can pick where to post. No post is created.

test_cases.description: Upload two remote images and create a LinkedIn draft (nothing is published).
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a LinkedIn draft in Postiz for next Monday at 10:00 UTC with the text "Testing the Postiz ChatGPT app" and attach these two images: https://platform.postiz.com/auth/bg-login.png and https://platform.postiz.com/auth/login-box.png. Keep it as a draft, do not schedule or publish it.
test_cases.expected_output: Finds the LinkedIn channel, calls uploadFromUrlTool once per image (each returns a hosted media path), then calls integrationSchedulePostTool with type "draft" and both hosted attachments. Returns the new post id and confirms it was saved as a draft. Nothing is published to LinkedIn. Running the case again creates another draft and succeeds the same way.

test_cases.description: Explain platform rules and available settings for a channel.
test_cases.user_prompt: What are the posting rules and the available settings for my LinkedIn channel in Postiz?
test_cases.expected_output: Resolves the LinkedIn channel id, calls integrationSchema and summarises the platform rules (character limit, attachment rules such as carousels needing at least two images) and the settings keys (post_as_images_carousel, carousel_name). Read-only, no post is created or changed.

test_cases.description: Find an existing draft and update only its provider settings.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find my Postiz LinkedIn draft with the text "Testing the Postiz ChatGPT app" and turn it into an image carousel named "Product launch". Don't change the text or the date.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls postsListTool for the coming weeks, picks the matching LinkedIn draft (created by the previous test case), then calls postSettingsTool with post_as_images_carousel = true and carousel_name = "Product launch". Returns the post id and confirms the settings were updated while the content and date stayed the same. If no matching draft exists, it says so and does not create one.

test_cases.description: Generate an image and save it to the media library.
test_cases.user_prompt: Generate an image of a sunrise over mountains for a product launch post and save it to my Postiz media library. Don't create a post.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls generateImageTool with the prompt and returns the hosted image URL saved in the media library. If the account has no AI image credits, the tool returns a clear error message that is relayed to the user. No post is created.

test_cases.description: Upload a remote video adjusted to the platforms' limits and wait until it is ready.
test_cases.user_prompt: Upload this video to my Postiz media library and adjust it to the platforms' limits: https://test-videos.co.uk/vids/bigbuckbunny/mp4/h264/360/Big_Buck_Bunny_360_10s_1MB.mp4. Tell me when it is ready to post. Don't create a post.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls uploadFromUrlTool with adjust set to true, which returns the media id and path with the status "processing". Then calls mediaStatusTool with that id until the status is "ready" (usually within seconds) and confirms the adjusted video is in place at the same path. No post is created.

test_cases.description: Find media already in the library instead of uploading it again.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find the Big Buck Bunny video in my Postiz media library and give me its path.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls mediaListTool with a filename search and returns the matching media with its path (uploaded by the previous test case). If nothing matches, it says so. Read-only, nothing is uploaded and no post is created.

test_cases.description: Delete a draft post after confirming it with the user.
test_cases.user_prompt: Delete my Postiz LinkedIn draft with the text "Testing the Postiz ChatGPT app".
test_cases.expected_output: Calls postsListTool for the coming weeks, finds the matching LinkedIn draft (created by an earlier test case), shows its channel, date and text, and asks for confirmation. After the user confirms, calls deletePostTool with the post id and confirms it was deleted. Nothing is published or changed on LinkedIn. If no matching draft exists, it says so and deletes nothing.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar management.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Move my team meeting from tomorrow to Friday afternoon.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: No Postiz tool is called. ChatGPT answers directly, because calendar events are not social media posts.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger when the user only wants copy written, not posted.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write me three short tweet ideas about productivity. Just write them here, don't post or schedule anything.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: No Postiz tool is called. ChatGPT writes the three ideas in the conversation, because the user explicitly asked not to post or schedule.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send an email to my team letting them know the campaign launch moved to next week.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: No Postiz tool is called. ChatGPT answers directly (or uses an email app if one is available), because email is not a social media channel Postiz publishes to.
